headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has accused Chinese AI developers of copying American models through a method he calls industrial distillation.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the interview probably dates from 3 Oct and only the headline of a video clip could be read, so the claim is unverified.
importance_line: Adds to US pressure on China over AI, affecting American labs and trade policy, but it is a spoken accusation with no evidence cited.
summary: Real Clear Politics posted a video on 4 Oct in which Bessent says Chinese AI models "do 'industrial distillation' -- which is a nice word for stealing from the U.S. models", remarks that related coverage places in his interview on The Axios Show on 3 Oct. Distillation means training one AI model on another model's answers; the accusation is Bessent's own and no evidence for it is cited.
notes: Headline only: RCP blocked, no transcript. Likely from the 3 Oct Axios Show interview.
